prompt: Consider the following three people:  1. Edmund, who turned 10 on the day of the Battle of Hastings 2. Edward, who turned 12 on the day that Guy Fawkes was executed 3. Eddie, who turned 14 on the day of the London 2012 Summer Olympics opening ceremony  Who would be oldest: Edmund on the day King Henry I of England died, Edward on the day of the Battle of Naseby, or Eddie on the day Liz Truss announced her resignation as Conservative Party leader?
answer:
**Edmund would be the oldest.**

- **Edmund:** Turned 10 on 14 October 1066, so he was born on 14 October 1056. King Henry I died on 1 December 1135, when Edmund was **79**.
- **Edward:** Turned 12 when Guy Fawkes was executed on 31 January 1606, so he was born on 31 January 1594. At the Battle of Naseby on 14 June 1645, he was **51**.
- **Eddie:** Turned 14 at the London Olympics opening ceremony on 27 July 2012, so he was born on 27 July 1998. When Liz Truss announced her resignation on 20 October 2022, he was **24**.

Therefore, **Edmund, at 79, would be oldest**.
